relations.subject: Susumu Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He studied Buddhism at Shinshu Ōtani College (Ōtani University). He completed the graduate course there

relations.subject: Susumu Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: became an assistant professor at his alma mater in 1924.

relations.subject: Susumu Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He was promoted to a professor of Ōtani University in 1934. ... He worked at Ōtani University by his retirement in 1964.

relations.subject: Susumu Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He also taught at Kyoto Imperial University from next year.

relations.subject: Susumu Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: In 1943, he submitted his doctoral dissertation to Kyoto Imperial University.

relations.subject: Susumu Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He served as the fifteenth principal of Ōtani University (1950-1958).

relations.object: Institute of Buddhism propagandism, Shinshu Ōtani-ha
